items.title: A canonical isomorphism between the determinant of the outer terms and the determinant of the middle term of a short exact sequence of finite length modules, with three compatibility properties
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical map gamma from det_kappa(K) tensor det_kappa(M) to det_kappa(L) on nonzero symbols [e_1, ..., e_k] tensor [fbar_1, ..., fbar_m] -> [e_1, ..., e_k, f_1, ..., f_m] and asserts three properties: equivariance for isomorphisms of short exact sequences, a square with a Koszul sign (-1)^{cg}, and agreement with the usual determinant isomorphism for kappa-vector spaces (statement lines 16202-16295, with two commutative diagrams drawn in Xy-pic). The subtlety is well definedness on nonzero symbols: an admissible sequence in K and one in M need not concatenate to an admissible sequence in L, and the value must be independent of the chosen lifts; the author resolves this by observing that a nonzero symbol forces K = <e_1, ..., e_k>, and then transfers each admissible relation separately (proof lines 16298-16319). Surjectivity of gamma is obtained from the generation statement for det_kappa(L) of the previous lemmas rather than from a direct computation (proof lines 16322-16328), and property (2) is a genuine sign computation carried out by applying the admissible relation of type (c) a total of cg times in a prescribed order (proof lines 16340-16362). The claim is a nontrivial diagram-level consistency statement, so it is H2.
